lines.en: : Hey! Since we’re already talking about kissing, how about bringing back our old tradition of playing spin the bottle on Christmas!?! That sounds fun, right?
lines.zh: : 嘿！既然都聊到接吻了，不如把我们在圣诞节玩转瓶子的老传统给捡回来？！听起来很有趣，对吧？

lines.en: : Gah! Get that thing away from me! I can’t afford to destroy any more relationships!
lines.zh: : 啊！把那东西拿远点！我可经不起再毁掉一段关系了！

lines.en: : Spin the bottle? I blacked out the last time you guys played this and can’t remember how it works.
lines.zh: : 转瓶子？上次你们玩这个的时候我断片了，不记得规则了。

lines.en: : It’s simple, really. Somebody spins a bottle and then has to kiss whoever it’s aiming at once it {i}stops{/i} spinning.
lines.zh: : 很简单，真的。有人转一个瓶子，等它{i}停{/i}下来时指向谁，就得亲谁。

lines.en: : But what if Kirin spins the bottle and it lands on me? We’re sisters. We’re not allowed to kiss or we’ll never make it into Heaven.
lines.zh: : 可要是 Kirin 转瓶子，它指着我呢？我们是姐妹。我们不能亲，不然就永远进不了天堂。

lines.en: : Actually, the Bible is packed to the brim with incest if you manage to filter through all the boring parts. Luckily for you, I have a sexually annotated version back in my room that I’d love to-
lines.zh: : 其实《圣经》里乱伦的情节多得都快溢出来了，只要你肯把无聊的部分过滤掉。算你走运，我房间里有一本性爱批注版，我很乐意——

lines.en: : Bad. We don’t corrupt Karin. It’s against the rules.
lines.zh: : 坏。我们不能把 Karin 带坏。这违反规矩。

lines.en: : So! Who’s up for a rousing game of “Kiss your friends while Imani is out of the room?!”
lines.zh: : 那么！有人想来一局激动人心的「趁 Imani 不在屋里亲朋友」吗？

lines.en: : That’s both irresponsible {i}and{/i} uncalled for! As the next oldest person at the party behind Miss Imai, I forbid this completely.
lines.zh: : 这既不负责任{i}又{/i}毫无道理！作为派对上仅次于 Imai 小姐的第二年长者，我完全禁止这件事。

lines.en: : Unfortunately for you, you’re my plus-one! So you don’t have any say in the fun and exciting games we play, big sister!
lines.zh: : 可惜你是我的随行嘉宾！所以我们玩什么有趣又刺激的游戏，你都没有发言权，姐姐！

lines.en: : Kirin, I highly doubt there is anyone else in this room who is even half as naughty as-
lines.zh: : Kirin，我非常怀疑这屋里还有谁能有你——
: 再猜一次，Karin！

lines.en: : My name is Rin Rokuhara...and I am here to spin a bottle.
lines.zh: : 我叫 Rin Rokuhara……而我是来转瓶子的。
: 我……我是不是该回避一下？

lines.en: : {i}No.{/i} I will accept my fate regardless of the circumstances.
lines.zh: : {i}不。{/i}无论什么情况，我都会接受自己的命运。

lines.en: : And if the bottle just so happens to land on Molly, I’ll just have to thank Futaba for always keeping a travel bottle of mouthwash in her bag.
lines.zh: : 而万一瓶子恰好指向 Molly，我就只能感谢 Futaba 总是在包里备着一瓶便携漱口水了。

lines.en: : That is, unless there is {i}someone{/i} here who would be disheartened to see me kiss another girl and would like to object before I make any rash decisions!
lines.zh: : 除非这里有{i}某个人{/i}看到我亲别的女孩会心碎，想在我做出任何草率的决定之前提出异议！

lines.en: : {i}I said...{/i}Unless there is {i}someone{/i} here who would be disheartened to see me kiss another girl and would like to object before I make any rash decisions!
lines.zh: : {i}我说了……{/i}除非这里有「某个人」看到我亲别的女孩会心碎，想在我做出任何草率的决定之前提出异议！

lines.en: : Why, I believe she’s talking about you.
lines.zh: : 哎呀，我觉得她说的是你。

lines.en: : Oh, really? Sorry. Was I supposed to say something there?
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？抱歉。刚才那儿我是不是该说点什么？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about. Do we even know each other? Because I don’t think we do. Who are you again?
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。我们甚至认识吗？因为我觉得不认识。你叫什么来着？

lines.en: : In the event that this bottle is aimed at me once it stops spinning, I hope you won’t hold it against me for inserting my tongue into the same mouth you used to insert your tongue into.
lines.zh: : 万一瓶子停下来时指着我，希望你别怪我把舌头伸进那个你曾经也伸过舌头的嘴里。

lines.en: : Did you really have to word it like that?
lines.zh: : 你非得这么措辞吗？

lines.en: : I’m gonna do it! I’m gonna spin the bottle! I sure hope no one stops me!
lines.zh: : 我要转了！我要转瓶子了！真希望没人拦着我！

lines.en: : {i}I sure hope no one stops me!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}真希望没人拦着我！{/i}

lines.en: : Oh no. Stop. Don’t do it.
lines.zh: : 哦不。停下。别转。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Futaba...but this is a decision I’ve made and I’ll have to-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Futaba……但这是我做出的决定，我必须——
: 好吧！玩得开心！

lines.en: : Wha- Futaba?! Since when do you give up so easily?! Get back here and talk me out of this!
lines.zh: : 什——Futaba？！你什么时候这么容易就放弃了？！回来劝劝我啊！

lines.en: : Oh my fucking god, just spin the bottle or sit down and give somebody else a turn! You’re hogging all the spotlight!
lines.zh: : 我操你妈的，你要么转瓶子，要么坐下让别人来！风头全让你一个人占了！

lines.en: : Aaaaah! Fine! I have nothing left to lose!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊！行吧！我已经没什么可失去的了！

lines.en: : Oh, good! You got one of your friends.
lines.zh: : 哦，好！你转到了一个朋友。

lines.en: : That was close. I thought for a second it was going to land on me.
lines.zh: : 好险。我还以为有一瞬间它要指向我了呢。

lines.en: : Sana’s first kiss is going to be with Rin?! Who could have ever predicted-
lines.zh: : Sana 的初吻要和 Rin 一起？！谁能预料到——

lines.en: : Actually, I guess that makes sense. After Sensei or me, I guess she’d be the most likely.
lines.zh: : 其实，我觉得这也说得通。除了 Sensei 和我，大概就她最有可能了。
: 你不是直女吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but crazier things have happened to me before. Kissing Sana was always a possibility.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我身上发生过更疯狂的事。亲 Sana 一直都是有可能的。

lines.en: : Congrats, Sana! Congrats, Rin! I always knew you two would end up together!
lines.zh: : 恭喜，Sana！恭喜，Rin！我就知道你俩最后会在一起的！

lines.en: : It appears that my fate has been decided.
lines.zh: : 看来我的命运已经注定了。
: 除非有{i}某个人{/i}站出来——

lines.en: : Nobody is going to fucking step in! Now shut up and kiss!
lines.zh: : 没人会他妈站出来！现在闭嘴亲！

lines.en: : Kirin! Don’t say the “K” word in public!
lines.zh: : Kirin！别在公共场合说那个「亲」字！
: 你是指那个「操」字吧？
: 不是！

lines.en: : I will do the kissing now. It is going to happen. With both of our mouths.
lines.zh: : 我现在要亲了。这事要发生了。用我们俩的嘴。

lines.en: : See? I’m not the only one who words things that way.
lines.zh: : 瞧？又不是只有我一个人这么措辞。

lines.en: : Here it comes. Here comes the kiss. Better...watch out! Better not cry!
lines.zh: : 来了。吻要来了。最好……当心！最好别哭！

lines.en: : Better not pout, I’m telling you why!
lines.zh: : 最好别闹，我来告诉你为什么！

lines.en: : Stop stalling and go, go, go!
lines.zh: : 别磨蹭了，快，快，快！
: 漂亮。

lines.en: : It...appears that our mouths have touched!
lines.zh: : 看来……我们的嘴碰上了！

lines.en: : Can we agree to add this to the list of things we will never speak about again?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能同意把这件事加进「永远不再提起的清单」里？

lines.en: : It appears that it is my turn to take a leap of faith and have what will definitely be my first kiss ever.
lines.zh: : 看来轮到我去冒一次险，献出我绝对意义上的初吻了。

lines.en: : Heck yeah! Knock ‘em dead, Kirin! Make it land on Makoto so I can see my two best friends smoochin’ on Christmas!
lines.zh: : 必须的！上吧，Kirin！让它落在 Makoto 身上，好让我看到我两个最好的朋友在圣诞节亲嘴！
: 我会尽力的。

lines.en: : What? No! Why is that a thing you want to see?
lines.zh: : 什么？不！你为什么想看那个？

lines.en: : Idunno. I think it’d be funny. Plus, you two would make cute babies.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我觉得会很好笑。而且你俩生的宝宝会很可爱。

lines.en: : Have you really not had the talk with Miku yet? I think she’s overdue.
lines.zh: : 你还没跟 Miku 谈过那件事吗？我觉得她早就该谈了。

lines.en: : God, I love this game. Why don’t we play it more often?
lines.zh: : 天啊，我太爱这个游戏了。我们为什么不多玩几次？

lines.en: : Probably because there are roughly only three people who actually want to participate.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为真正想参与的人只有三个左右吧。

lines.en: : Kirin! Stop! I can’t let you do this! As your older sister and current chaperone of the Christmas party, it’s my responsibility to make sure-
lines.zh: : Kirin！停下！我不能让你这么做！作为你的姐姐，也是这场圣诞派对当前的监护人，我有责任确保——

lines.en: : Oh, are you guys playing spin the bottle? What did I miss? Who’s kissed who?
lines.zh: : 哦，你们在玩转瓶子？我错过了什么？谁亲了谁？

lines.en: : It’s just been Rin and Sana so far.
lines.zh: : 到目前为止只有 Rin 和 Sana。

lines.en: : Ahh, I guess that explains why the two of them look so shell-shocked. Anyway, knock ‘em dead Kirin. I hope it lands on Makoto so Miku can see her two best friends kiss.
lines.zh: : 啊，那大概就能解释为什么她俩看起来像被炮弹轰过一样。总之，上吧 Kirin。我希望它落在 Makoto 身上，好让 Miku 看到她两个最好的朋友接吻。
: 亲！亲！亲！

lines.en: : Ayane, does Miss Imai hate me? Because I really think she might.
lines.zh: : Ayane，Imai 小姐是不是讨厌我？因为我真的觉得她可能讨厌我。

lines.en: : Miss Imai, are you really okay with the girls playing such a...lewd and...inappropriate game?!
lines.zh: : Imai 小姐，女孩们玩这种……下流又……不合适的游戏，你真的没问题吗？！

lines.en: : Yeah. Are we, like...actually allowed to do this?
lines.zh: : 是啊。我们真的……可以这么做吗？

lines.en: : Lewd? Y’all ain’t playin’ spin the Henny, are you? Because {i}that{/i} shit I ain’t allowing. Never ends well.
lines.zh: : 下流？你们不是在玩转 Henny 吧？因为{i}那个{/i}我可不许。从来没好结果。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure it’s a bottle of wine. It was on the table when we got here.
lines.zh: : 我挺确定那是瓶葡萄酒。我们来的时候就摆在桌子上了。

lines.en: : Then yeah, y’all are Gucci. Kissing’s totally cool. Don’t need my permission for that. Just keep your hands to yourselves in the room and go hide in the bathroom if you {i}need{/i} to do more.
lines.zh: : 那就没事，你们随便。亲亲完全没问题。这种事不用我批准。只要在屋里把手放老实点，要是{i}需要{/i}做更多就去卫生间躲着。
: 更多？！还有什么？！

lines.en: : Sorry, Molly! Don’t have all day! Need to kiss girls now!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Molly！没时间！现在要去亲女孩子了！

lines.en: : Kirin, stop! I’ll support you no matter who you love, but I don’t want to watch my little sister...k...{i}kiss{/i} someone!
lines.zh: : Kirin，停下！不管你爱谁我都会支持你，但我不想看着我妹妹……亲……「{i}亲{/i}」别人！

lines.en: : Then close your eyes, Karin! Because there ain’t no turnin’ back now!
lines.zh: : 那就闭上眼睛，Karin！因为现在可没有回头路了！

lines.en: : Okay. Maybe we {i}shouldn’t{/i} be playing this game. Because I ain’t familiar enough with the legal system to know whether or not what’s about to go down is allowed.
lines.zh: : 好吧。也许我们「{i}不该{/i}」玩这个游戏。因为我对法律体系不够熟，不知道接下来要发生的事到底合不合法。

lines.en: : Heck yeah! This is even better than Kirin and Makoto! Kirin and Karin’s a whole new level of awesome!
lines.zh: : 必须的！这比 Kirin 和 Makoto 还精彩！Kirin 和 Karin 是全新高度的牛逼！
: 天啊……我不敢看。
: 我不敢{i}移开{/i}视线。
: 圣诞快乐，Noriko。

lines.en: : Ahh, the gift of love. How beautiful.
lines.zh: : 啊，爱的馈赠。多美啊。

lines.en: : Damn it, Tsuneyo. We were {i}this{/i} close to seeing one of my top tags come to life. How come bad things always happen on Christmas?
lines.zh: : 该死，Tsuneyo。我们就差{i}这么{/i}一点，就能看到我排名前列的一个 tag 变成现实了。为什么坏事总发生在圣诞节？

lines.en: : Probably because bad things are always happening in every facet of the tragic lives we live.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为在我们过的这些悲惨人生里，坏事在每个方面都在不断发生。

lines.en: : But tragedy is just the spice we use to-
lines.zh: : 可悲剧不过是我们用来——

lines.en: : Didn’t you already get a wistful Christmas monologue at one of our other parties? Can’t you let somebody else handle this one?
lines.zh: : 你在我们别的哪场派对上不是已经做过一次伤感的圣诞独白了吗？这次就不能让别人来吗？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, there is no one in this room more talented and better at speaking than me. But I will remain silent if it allows the rest of you to feel as if you are sufficient.
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，这屋里没有谁比我更有才华、更会讲话。不过如果保持沉默能让你们其余人觉得自己还算够用，那我就闭嘴。

lines.en: : Hello, madam. Care for a drink?
lines.zh: : 你好，女士。要喝一杯吗？

lines.en: : Sure. If by “drink” you mean “quick makeout session while everyone watches.”
lines.zh: : 好啊。如果你说的「喝一杯」是指「在所有人面前快速亲热一番」的话。
: 我指的是「喝一杯」。

lines.en: : Yeah, I’ll just...take this for a second. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那我就……先拿走这个。谢了。
: 算了。酒没了。

lines.en: : First the mistletoe, now the bottle. It’s kind of like fate itself {i}wants{/i} us to kiss today.
lines.zh: : 先是槲寄生，现在是瓶子。感觉就像是命运本身{i}想{/i}让我们今天接吻。

lines.en: : Sure. Except for the part where the bottle didn’t actually land on me and your sister gave it to me as a Christmas present.
lines.zh: : 是啊。除了瓶子其实没指到我，是你姐姐把它当圣诞礼物递给了我。

lines.en: : Honestly, though...if you really think about it, it’s kind of weird that we {i}haven’t{/i} kissed yet.
lines.zh: : 不过说实话……你要是真想想，我们{i}还没{/i}接过吻，其实挺奇怪的。
: 是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I mean...we definitely flirt with each other more than any other dorm. And between the way you throw yourself at Sensei and the way I throw myself at...uhh...
lines.zh: : 是啊。我的意思是……我们调情的次数肯定比其他任何宿舍都多。而且你往 Sensei 身上扑，我往……呃……
: 往一切东西上扑？
: 对。你说的对。

lines.en: : Between all of that, it just feels a little weird that we keep postponing it when we know it’ll happen eventually. Like...shouldn’t we just rip the bandage off now and go for it?
lines.zh: : 综合以上种种，既然我们知道这事迟早会发生，却一直拖着，感觉就有点怪。就像……我们是不是该干脆现在把创可贴一撕了之，直接上？

lines.en: : I suppose that’s a relatively mature way of approaching this situation.
lines.zh: : 我想，这算是处理这种情况相对成熟的方式。

lines.en: : There is no use in delaying the inevitable, after all. And this may have a positive effect on our lives from this point onward if we go through with it. But to what extent, I’m not sure.
lines.zh: : 毕竟，拖延不可避免的事毫无用处。而且如果我们真做了，也许从今往后会对我们的人生产生积极的影响。不过到什么程度，我不确定。

lines.en: : It’s like Gandhi once said. “The future depends on what we do in the present.”
lines.zh: : 就像甘地曾说过的。「未来取决于我们在当下所做的一切。」

lines.en: : And the present is now. Which means we must kiss.
lines.zh: : 而当下的现在。也就是说我们必须接吻。

lines.en: : Correct. It’s what Gandhi would want.
lines.zh: : 没错。这是甘地想要的。

lines.en: : Well, we definitely don’t want to disappoint Gandhi.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我们绝对不想让甘地失望。
: 为了未来。
: 为了甘地。
: Mmf...

lines.en: : Yeaaaah! Get your tongue in there!
lines.zh: : 耶————！把舌头伸进去！

lines.en: : Miku, you’re clearly misreading just how much they actually want to-
lines.zh: : Miku，你显然高估了她们实际有多想——
: Mm!~
: Mmf...mnch...mmm!

lines.en: : Girls! What barrier is there that love cannot break?! Your action expresses your priorities! In doing something, do it with love or never do it at all!
lines.zh: : 姑娘们！有什么壁垒是爱无法打破的？！你们的行动昭示着你们真正在乎什么！做一件事，就要带着爱去做，否则干脆别做！
: {i}咳。{/i}好、好的！

lines.en: : Be the change you wish to see in the-
lines.zh: : 成为你希望在——
: 甘地其实从没说过那句话。
: 什么？

lines.en: : {i}Yeah. The actual quote is like a paragraph long, but the closest he comes is “If we could change ourselves, the tendencies in the world would also change.”{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是啊。原话有整整一段那么长，最接近的一句是「如果我们能改变自己，世界的趋势也会随之改变。」{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Oh that wouldn’t look good on posters or bags at all. I get why we changed it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，那印在海报和包上可一点都不好看。我明白我们为什么改了。{/i}
: {size=-10}{i}正是！你瞧……我们作为一个社会——{/i}{/size}

lines.en: : Ahh...Christmas. Or as we called it back in Nam — the smooching holiday.
lines.zh: : 啊……圣诞节。或者说，按我们在 Nam 时的叫法——亲嘴节。

lines.en: : Why are girls kissing each other? Transference can only occur between a man and a woman. They are going to darken their souls with such inappropriate contact.
lines.zh: : 为什么女孩要互相亲？Transference 只可能发生在男女之间。她们这样不恰当的接触，会让自己的灵魂蒙上阴影。

lines.en: : Yasu? When the heck did {i}you{/i} get here? We ain’t seen ya all night and the party’s already in full force now that we’re spinnin’ bottles.
lines.zh: : Yasu？{i}你{/i}「到底什么时候」来的？我们一整晚都没见着你，现在瓶子都转起来了，派对正热闹。

lines.en: : I’ve been here the whole night. Your eyes just neglected to inform you that my existence is worth paying any attention to. And rightfully so!
lines.zh: : 我整晚都在这儿。只是你们的眼睛懒得告诉你们，我的存在值得你们关注。理应如此！

lines.en: : No. You, like...literally ain’t been here. I’ve been standin’ near the door.
lines.zh: : 不。你是……真的不在这儿。我一直站在门边。

lines.en: : I was in the other party room. With our new classmates.
lines.zh: : 我在另一个派对房间里。和我们的新同学一起。

lines.en: : Yasu...we ain’t gettin’ any new classmates. And we’ve only got one party room.
lines.zh: : Yasu……我们不会有什么新同学的。而且我们只有一个派对房间。
: 那这是谁给我的？

lines.en: : Is that a frickin’ crab?! Where the hell’d you get a crab?!
lines.zh: : 那是一只该死的螃蟹？！你从哪个鬼地方弄来的螃蟹？！
: 另一个派对房间。

lines.en: : I already told ya! We ain’t got another party room! Which means ya wandered into some stranger’s hotel and...I still don’t know how the crab comes into play here! The heck was goin’ on in that room?!
lines.zh: : 我都说了！我们没有另一个派对房间！也就是说你逛进了某个陌生人的酒店，而且……我还是不明白螃蟹在这事儿里是怎么出现的！那个房间里到底在搞什么鬼？！

lines.en: : I’m unsure. They did not speak the same language as me — and they neglected to take the words of my Lord to heart when I tried to inform them of His message.
lines.zh: : 我不确定。他们跟我说的是不同的语言——我试图向他们传达主的话语时，他们也没把主的话放在心上。

lines.en: : But they were very nice and gave me food they cooked in a large pot! As well as this award for winning a game they called “Jenga!”
lines.zh: : 但他们非常友善，还给了我他们在一口大锅里煮的食物！还有这个奖，因为我赢了一个他们叫「叠叠乐」的游戏！

lines.en: : Makoto! Get your butt over here! Yasu won a crab from a Jenga match against strangers and I ain’t equipped to handle this like you are!
lines.zh: : Makoto！快过来！Yasu 跟陌生人玩叠叠乐赢了一只螃蟹，我可没你那么能处理这种事！
: 呃。又来？

lines.en: : Again?! How often does this happen?!
lines.zh: : 又来？！这种事多久发生一次？！

lines.en: : The time has come for the Gem of the Emerald Isle to redeem herself and reclaim the pride of her motherland.
lines.zh: : 是时候让翡翠岛的宝石救赎自己，重拾祖国的荣光了。

lines.en: : And...how exactly will kissing some girl decided by a bottle make Ireland proud of you?
lines.zh: : 而……亲一个由瓶子决定的女孩，到底怎么才能让爱尔兰为你骄傲？

lines.en: : How foolish. The succubus has clearly never studied the practices of your homeland, Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 何其愚蠢。这个魅魔显然从未研习过你家乡的习俗，翡翠守护者。
: 魅魔？
: 砰。唰。笑话讲完。
: 嘿。那是{i}我{/i}的台词。
: 诅咒就在今天终结！
: 远古……巨龙……斜线……旋转突进！

lines.en: : You’d never survive the Battle of Kumon-mi with weak ability names like that.
lines.zh: : 就凭你这种软弱的能力名，你根本活不过 Kumon-mi 之战。

lines.en: : Silence, mortal! My fate is in your hands now, bottle!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴，凡人！我的命运现在就交到你手里了，瓶子！

lines.en: : Ahh! No fair! That’s who {i}I{/i} wanted! How come Molly gets Imani and I get my roommate?!
lines.zh: : 啊！不公平！那是「{i}我{/i}」想要的人！凭什么 Molly 亲到 Imani，我只能亲我的室友？！

lines.en: : Wow! Okay, Kirin! Last time I kiss you in public.
lines.zh: : 哇！行吧，Kirin！我再也不在公共场合亲你了。

lines.en: : You don’t want me. I’m a 6/10.
lines.zh: : 你不想要我。我是个 6/10。

lines.en: : And I’m likely a 3! It matters not to me, Miss Imai!
lines.zh: : 而我大概是 3！这对我无关紧要，Imai 小姐！

lines.en: : P...Please be gentle, though. I am quite frail.
lines.zh: : 不……不过请温柔点。我相当脆弱。

lines.en: : And {i}I{/i} am quite thirsty. Anyone want a drink from the gift shop? One that {i}isn’t{/i} Dr. Pepper or wine since those are the only beverages we thought to bring this year?
lines.zh: : 而{i}我{/i}相当渴。有人想喝点从礼品店买的东西吗？{i}不是{/i}Dr. Pepper 或葡萄酒的那种，毕竟今年我们只想到带这两种饮料。
: 等、等等！我的吻！

lines.en: : Oh! Yeah, sorry. I’m kind of busy for the next few years, so if you could just wait until then, that’d be {i}great.{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦！对，抱歉。接下来几年我有点忙，所以你要是能等到那时候，那就{i}太好了{/i}。

lines.en: : I bet Sensei would never saymnmmfppphphph?!?!
lines.zh: : 我打赌 Sensei 绝不会说唔嗯嗯嗯呼呼？！？！

lines.en: : Please be quiet. All of your yelling is starting to give me a headache.
lines.zh: : 请安静点。你们的喊叫开始让我头疼了。
: 什么？！……放开我，鸟女！

lines.en: {i}Further away...in the second half of town...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}更远处……在城镇的另一半……{/i}
